levels.name: Hop
levels.tip: Point where you want to fly, then click. You launch that way.

levels.name: Gap
levels.tip: Shots refill when you land. Yellow orbs refill you mid-air.

levels.name: Corridor
levels.tip: Spikes above, below, and in the middle. Short, controlled bursts.

levels.name: Climb
levels.tip: Chain shots and orbs to go up and over.

levels.name: Gauntlet
levels.tip: Everything so far, at once.

levels.name: Swing
levels.tip: Fly into a red orb's ring to grab it. Fire to let go and keep your speed.

levels.name: Vines
levels.tip: Grabbing refills your shots. Chain the swings.

levels.name: Chain
levels.tip: Four swings, three spike pillars. Don't touch the floor.

levels.name: Canopy
levels.tip: Let go at the top of the swing to gain height.

levels.name: Trapeze
levels.tip: One shot. The swings do the rest.

levels.name: Phase
levels.tip: PURPLE orbs let you pass through walls. The goal stays locked until you touch purple again.

levels.name: Vault
levels.tip: Phase in. Turn solid on the inside.

levels.name: Maze
levels.tip: Solve the maze, or skip it.

levels.name: Double Lock
levels.tip: Phase, unlock, phase again, unlock again.

levels.name: Ghost Walk
levels.tip: Walls can't stop you. Spikes still can.

levels.name: Portal
levels.tip: ORANGE orbs come in pairs. Enter one, exit the other at the same speed.

levels.name: Relay
levels.tip: Not every portal goes where you want.

levels.name: Switchback
levels.tip: Three sealed rooms. Find the way through.

levels.name: Freefall
levels.tip: Portals keep your speed. Use that.

levels.name: Crossfire
levels.tip: Four portal pairs. Two of them are traps.

levels.name: Flip
levels.tip: BLUE orbs flip gravity. Landing on the ceiling refills your shots.

levels.name: Upside
levels.tip: The goal is on the ceiling. So are the spikes.

levels.name: Ceiling Run
levels.tip: Run the ceiling, then come back down.

levels.name: Pinball
levels.tip: Flip mid-air. The pocket only opens on the right.

levels.name: Slalom
levels.tip: Walls from above and below. Gravity decides which way is up.

levels.name: Sweepers
levels.tip: Moving spikes start moving on your first shot. Time it.

levels.name: Conveyor
levels.tip: The floor is safe. The floor is not safe.

levels.name: Storm
levels.tip: Everything moves.

levels.name: Pistons
levels.tip: Same rhythm, different timing.

levels.name: Clockwork
levels.tip: Windows open and close. Go through them.

levels.name: Lift
levels.tip: Moving platforms carry you. Standing on one refills your shots.

levels.name: Ferry
levels.tip: One shot. Ride across, and don't fall off.

levels.name: Rush Hour
levels.tip: One shot. Elevators and moving spikes. Read both.

levels.name: Shaft
levels.tip: Elevators and a spiked ceiling. Get off before the top.

levels.name: Stack
levels.tip: Climb the moving stairs.

levels.name: Shove
levels.tip: PUSHERS knock you away. Pinned against a wall = crushed.

levels.name: Piston Hall
levels.tip: Pistons slam down from the ceiling.

levels.name: Compactor
levels.tip: Walls close in. Don't be there when they meet.

levels.name: Grinder
levels.tip: Pushers shove you toward the spikes.

levels.name: Launchpad
levels.tip: A pusher hits hard. Ride the hit.

levels.name: Gate
levels.tip: Lasers switch on and off. A faint line warns you first.

levels.name: Crossbeam
levels.tip: Diagonal lasers. Watch the angles.

levels.name: Grid
levels.tip: Up, down, across. Something is always on.

levels.name: Strobe
levels.tip: Fast lasers. Faster decisions.

levels.name: Rhythm
levels.tip: Three gates, one beat.

levels.name: Sentry
levels.tip: GUNSHIPS aim where you are, charge up, then fire. Walls block the beam.

levels.name: Bunker Run
levels.tip: Hide, then run.

levels.name: Crossfire Two
levels.tip: Two ships. Keep moving.

levels.name: Patrol
levels.tip: This one moves.

levels.name: Armada
levels.tip: Three ships. Find the gaps in their timing.

levels.name: Zero-G Gunfight
levels.tip: Gravity, gunships, swing.

levels.name: Overdrive
levels.tip: Swing, portal, lasers.

levels.name: Inversion
levels.tip: Gravity, moving spikes, swing.

levels.name: Signal Lost
levels.tip: Phase, lasers, gunship.

levels.name: Warp Core
levels.tip: Portals, phase, elevators, lasers.

levels.name: Freight
levels.tip: One shot. Elevators, pushers, moving spikes.

levels.name: Night Shift
levels.tip: Elevator, gunship, phase.

levels.name: Piston Portal
levels.tip: Pushers, portals, lasers.

levels.name: Everything
levels.tip: Phase. Swing. Flip. Dodge. Every mechanic, one run.

levels.name: Final Exam
levels.tip: You know everything now. Prove it.
